The '''Dealer's Den''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the far corner of the [[Concourse Lounges]] section of the [[Old Galactic Market]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It offered drinks, dancers and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] as its entertainment. Most of its patrons were the seedier denizens of Coruscant society, such as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealers and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] thug named [[Gambo]] and his cronies had their own lounge, whereas the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] vendor named [[Edvaalda]] operated openly there.

Two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the conclusion of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] met with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Canderous Ordo]] at the Dealer's Den.

During the [[Galactic War]], the freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]] maintained a base in the back room of the cantina.<ref name="Shroud">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|The Shroud's Gambit|Coruscant}}</ref>
